ENTR 500: Practical and theortical insights into analyzing a new business opportunity that you have created.

ENTR 810: This course explores emerging trends and disruptors in technology and industry that create new markets and influence decision making, product development, business models, and business practices associated with innovation.
ENTR 820: This course is designed to survey and explore the methods used to foster innovation and entrepreneurship in a corporate setting.
ENTR 830: This course is designed to allow students to integrate, synthesize, and apply what they have learned in prior courses, and gain further insight into two major drivers of business success, innovation and entrepreneurship.
